description: Read the conversation a message belongs to. `threadId` is the conversation ROOT's SMTP Message-ID — the value a `list_events` row or a `get_email` answer carries as `threadId` — and an intermediate message id also resolves to the whole chain. Returns the chain oldest-first, each entry with the same projection `get_email` uses, plus `bodyTruncated` on the entries whose body was shortened (the window is bounded so a long thread cannot become a way to pull a whole mailbox) and `total` / `hasMoreOlder` / `hasMoreNewer` saying whether the chain extends past the window. A thread of another tenant answers `message_not_found`.

domainId.description: Optional: the id of the domain that received the message. Narrows the lookup to one mailbox.

threadId.description: The conversation root's SMTP Message-ID — the `threadId` value from a `list_events` row or a `get_email` answer.

name: get_thread
